description: This file defines the 'DocumentElements' class, which manages a collection of document elements such as paragraphs, tables, images, and charts within the MigraDoc library. It provides methods for adding various element types, cloning, serialization, and visitor pattern implementation.

classes.name: DocumentElements
classes.description: Represents a collection of document elements such as paragraphs, tables, images, and charts within a document. Provides methods for managing and serializing these elements.

classes.name: DocumentElements.DocumentElementsValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for DocumentElements, linked to the owner document object.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the DocumentElements collection.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph to the collection, optionally with text and style.

methods.name: AddTable
methods.description: Creates and adds a new table to the collection.

methods.name: AddLegend
methods.description: Creates and adds a legend element to the collection.

methods.name: AddPageBreak
methods.description: Adds a page break element to the collection.

methods.name: AddBarcode
methods.description: Creates and adds a barcode element to the collection.

methods.name: AddChart
methods.description: Creates and adds a chart of a specified type to the collection.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Creates and adds an image with a specified name to the collection.

methods.name: AddTextFrame
methods.description: Creates and adds a text frame to the collection.
